name: zapier-onboard
title_zh: Zapier MCP 新用户上手指南，从认证到分流
tagline_zh: 刚装好 Zapier MCP 不知道下一步？它带你走完认证，再根据你搭到哪一步，决定是演示、排错还是直接开连。
tagline_en: Just installed Zapier MCP? It walks you through auth, then routes you to demo, troubleshooting, or connecting—no.
desc_en: Onboard a new user to Zapier MCP — introduce what it can do, walk through authentication, and route into the right flow based on the state of their setup. Use when getting started, troubleshooting connection issues, or when the user asks "what is Zapier MCP", "how do I get started with Zapier", "set me up", "what can I do with Zapier", or "tell me about Zapier".
why_zh: 不是死板教程，而是先探你当前状态再分流：没认证就教认证，连不上就查连接，已就绪就演示能力。
why_en: Not a static tutorial—it probes your setup state first, then routes: auth if missing, troubleshoot if broken, demo if ready.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Zapier 官方 MCP 的 onboarding 场景；不处理具体 Zap 的搭建逻辑。
limit_en: Only covers official Zapier MCP onboarding. No Zap-building logic, no custom fields. If already authed and no errors, it just demos once and stops.
title_en: Zapier MCP onboarding: auth to right flow
